To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
spatiotopic coding in human visual cortex depends on spatial attention.
the neural substrate of spatiotopic coding in the brain depends critically on spatial attention.
spatiotopic tuning of BOLD responses in human visual cortex depends on spatial attention, and that the spatiotopic maps are more extensive than previously believed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the neural mechanisms of visual attention.
the neural substrate of the perceptual experience of a stable world.
the neural substrate of the perceptual experience of a stable and coherent world.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
spatiotopic coding is not an inherent property of the visual system, but it depends on the attentional state of the subjects.
spatiotopic coding in human visual cortex is dependent on the attentional state.
spatiotopic coding of the BOLD signal is not always present in human visual cortex and depends on the level of attention.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
spatial attention is required to construct a spatiotopic representation of a visual scene.
spatiotopic coding of BOLD signal depends on spatial attention, and that spatiotopically-tuned BOLD signals are more likely to be observed in the presence of spatial attention.
spatiotopic responses in human MT+ are only observed when subjects are not attending to the stimuli, and are not observed under conditions where subjects are attending to the stimuli.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the spatiotopic coding of the BOLD signal is dependent on spatial attention, suggesting that the spatiopically tuned BOLD responses in visual cortex reflect the attentional state of the subject.
the spatiotopic coding of BOLD signal in human visual cortex is not a default property, but is dependent on the level of spatial attention.
spatiotopic maps are not fixed but can be dynamically constructed by the brain depending on the demands of the task.
